_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); pharmaceutical signals

pit_profile.why: 'is a global specialty biopharmaceutical company whose mission is to discover, develop and deliver innovative medicines that help patients prevail over serious diseases.' (Item 1A heading); 'We depend on several key products for most of our revenues, cash flows and earnings.' (Item 1A heading)

BEAR.desc: EPS -46.3%/yr (worst year FY09-FY18 ex-FY15 ex-FY17, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +15.1%/yr (Q2 sales ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY15 ex-FY17 median

BULL.desc: EPS +15.1%/yr (FY09-FY18 ex-FY15 ex-FY17 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +48.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY09-FY18 ex-FY15 ex-FY17); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: BMY (retrospective, 2019-08-23) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.34x (69.9% downside to Bear $14 / +207.0% upside to Bull $143) | Adj composite 3.40 vs market 1.46: gap +1.94 [UNDERVALUED] | -23% above the EPP floor $60 (16x FY19E $3.78) | Conservative 2-yr case: +125.3% total (+62.7%/yr) | At 12.3x FY19E the 15% hurdle price $62 sits at or below the BASE case; U.S. revenues +13.5% in Q2 2019, forward revenues +13% (no FY19 revenue guide in numbers, Q2 2019 net sales growth ex-FX); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
